name: You Look Upon the Tarrasque

• Run and Hide — Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn.
• Gather Your Courage — Target creature gets +5/+5 and gains indestructible until end of turn. All creatures your opponents control able to block that creature this turn do so.

needs.what: a one-shot, this-turn, combat-only prevention over the permanents a player controls that match a selector ('creatures you control'), matched on the damaged permanent's current characteristics as the damage would be dealt (615.1), alongside the combat_only prevent_damage shield over the player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage with combat_only covers the seat ('you') but not its permanents; prevent_damage_permanent with combat_only shields objects chosen at resolution, so a creature that arrives or changes control later in the turn would be judged by the board the spell saw; prevent_combat_damage is keyed to the dealer, not the recipient
